issue_1_clinical_phenotypes.symptom: B.clinical_phenotypes F1=0 in both old and new reports
issue_1_clinical_phenotypes.root_cause: The pipeline does not extract B.clinical_phenotypes at all. All 20 entries show match_type=missing (extracted=None). The expected values are semicolon-joined strings like 'parkinsonism; tremor; rigidity', but this is irrelevant since the field is never produced.
issue_1_clinical_phenotypes.fix_location: Not fixable via evaluator or ground truth — the extraction prompt/model does not produce this field
issue_1_clinical_phenotypes.recommended_action: Mark as expected gap. The field enriches ground truth completeness but cannot improve F1 until the extraction pipeline adds clinical phenotype extraction.
issue_1_clinical_phenotypes.impact_on_recall: Adds 20 expected fields that are never matched, reducing recall by approximately 20/(total_expected_fields)

issue_2_gene_disease_relationship.symptom: A.gene_disease_relationship F1=0.0952 in both old and new reports
issue_2_gene_disease_relationship.root_cause: Expected value is 'associated' (generic), but system extracts 'causative' (LRRK2, PINK1, PARK2, VPS35, GIGYF2) or 'susceptibility' (GBA). The normalizer normalize_gene_disease_relationship() does not recognize 'associated' — it falls through to the raw string 'associated' which doesn't match 'causative' or 'susceptibility'.
issue_2_gene_disease_relationship.normalizer_gap: 'associated' is not in _GDR_CANONICAL and doesn't match any _GDR_PATTERNS
issue_2_gene_disease_relationship.fix_location: benchmark/core/field_normalize.py — add 'associated' to _GDR_CANONICAL or add pattern
issue_2_gene_disease_relationship.medical_rationale: For monogenic PD genes (LRRK2, PINK1, PRKN, VPS35), 'causative' is the correct ClinGen term. GBA is a susceptibility/risk factor. 'associated' in ground truth is a conservative umbrella term. Mapping 'associated' → 'causative' is acceptable since most entries are causative genes.

recall_impact_analysis.description: New expected fields that are never extracted by the pipeline reduce recall. 20 clinical_phenotypes fields (all missing) + 17 inheritance fields (13 matched, 4 missing) + 19 variant_type fields (6 matched, 13 missing) = 56 new expected fields, of which only ~19 are matched, adding ~37 false negatives.
recall_impact_analysis.explanation: TP increased but expected count also increased proportionally, so recall stayed flat. The enrichment added fields the pipeline can't extract (phenotypes) and fields it can partially extract (inheritance, variant_type).

fix_plan.action: Add 'associated' as synonym for 'causative' in gene_disease_relationship normalizer
No fix for B.clinical_phenotypes — pipeline capability gap
fix_plan.impact: None. F1 will remain 0 until pipeline adds phenotype extraction.
